vMatrix.notes: Fifth job and the V Matrix open at Lv. 200, so none of this applies yet at Lv. 140 - it is the next planning horizon after 4th job and hyper skills. The class doc is explicit that its node order is a preference, not a fixed rule, and that you should unlock most or all nodes before maxing any of them. Boost node and enhancement maximum level is 60. Nautilus Strike is the class's counter-intuitive pick: it is boosted despite never being cast, purely for the final-attack lines it grants to other skills.

order.step: Unlock some HEXA Mastery nodes first, then unlock Sol Janus.
order.why: The class doc places Sol Janus immediately after the first masteries because it carries farming and daily/weekly clear speed; the doc notes Buccaneer's mobbing was considered below average before Sol Janus levelled the field between classes.

order.step: Level Sol Janus to a breakpoint that matches how much you actually farm: stay at 1 if you only do dailies and weeklies; go to 10 if you farm at least 30 minutes; go to 20 if you farm with WAPs; go to 30 only if you are farming heavily or pushing past Lv. 290.
order.why: Sol Janus gains its real upgrades at levels 10, 20 and 30; the levels in between only add damage and EXP, so stopping partway to the next breakpoint wastes the investment.
order.consensus: weak (one current source, but the 10/20/30 breakpoint structure is confirmed as game data on maplestorywiki)

order.step: Start HEXA Stat only after several skills are at level 10.
order.why: Stated sequencing in the class doc; maxing a HEXA Stat core costs roughly 300 fragments on average.

order.step: For HEXA Stat, choose three main stats from Attack, Strength, Boss Damage and Critical Damage; level to 20 and stop there for now.
order.why: The doc's position is that a higher main stat is better but resetting past level 20 is min-max only. Duplicate main stats are not allowed across cores, so the chosen stats are rotated between HEXA Stat I, II and III (or a calculator is used).

hexa.notes: SOURCING GAP - READ THIS. The Buccaneer Bible does contain a full HEXA node levelling priority chart, updated 2026-09-10 for the Frieren Collab patch and explicitly including the new Common node, but it is published as an embedded image, not as text. It could not be extracted here and has deliberately NOT been guessed at. An earlier automated extraction of this same document produced a plausible-looking numbered HEXA order; re-reading the document's raw text showed no such list exists, so that ordering was a fabrication and was discarded. Anyone completing this field must read the chart image by eye or ask in the Buccaneer Discord. Verified node names for the planner's allowlist (maplestorywiki): Skill Node 1 (Origin) = Unleash Neptunus; Skill Node 2 (Ascent) = Haymaker; Mastery Node 1 = HEXA Octopunch; Mastery Node 2 = HEXA Sea Serpent and HEXA Nautilus Strike; Mastery Node 3 = HEXA Serpent Scale; Mastery Node 4 = HEXA Hook Bomber; HEXA Enhancements = Lightning Form Boost, Lord of the Deep Boost, Serpent Vortex Boost, Howling Fist Boost. Sixth job opens at Lv. 260, so this is far beyond a Lv. 140 character.

priority.why: The class doc's stated allocation rule is to spread the majority of points roughly evenly across the first four and dump the remainder into Attack and STR. Critical Rate is deliberately absent because Buccaneer is already above 100% critical rate against bosses.
EXP first, then the doc recommends using Legion and hyper stats together to reach a workable critical rate for mobbing (unlike bossing, mobbing crit is not self-capped).

hyperStats.notes: The class doc states outright that there is no standardised Buccaneer hyper stat build and that the optimum varies with your progression, and it points readers at SuckHard's hyper stat calculator for a per-character answer. The orders above are a priority of allocation, not a fixed point spread. A worked example the doc gives for a Lv. 280 character at 300% boss DEF is STR 3 / Critical Damage 13 / IED 10 / Damage 13 / Boss Damage 14 / Attack 7, and for training Critical Rate 6 / Critical Damage 11 / Damage 12 / Monster Damage 12 / Attack 5 / EXP 15. Hyper stat points begin at Lv. 140, so this is the first of these systems a Lv. 140 Buccaneer can actually act on.

innerAbility.consensus: moderate on the ideal three lines (class doc and Grandis Library list the same three, but Grandis credits the class doc, so it is one lineage); weak on everything else (class doc only)
innerAbility.notes: Buff Duration being a first-class Buccaneer inner ability line is a 6th-job-era change, tied to keeping buffs up through the Origin skill window. On Heroic specifically the doc prefers Meso Obtained during the progression phase over the ideal damage set.

gearingNotes: CRITICAL RATE: Buccaneer exceeds the critical rate cap against bosses from its own passives with no outside help, so bossing hyper stat points should not go into Critical Rate. The class does still want 100% visual critical rate, purely to trigger Hayato's Moonlight Blade Learnings link skill. The doc enumerates the cheap sources as Legion Familiar badges 3%, base 5%, Legion members Night Lord and Marksman 8-10%, Decent Sharp Eyes 10%, Precision Strikes 15%, Shadow Heart 20%, Legion Artifact 20% - totalling 81-83% - and fills the gap with the Lynn link (10% crit plus 10% damage), Legion grid blocks, and as little hyper stat as possible because the higher crit hyper stat levels return poorly. ATTACK SPEED: the knuckle chain is attack speed 5 base, 7 with Speed Infusion, 9 with Knuckle Mastery, and exactly 10 with a green potion - so a green potion is required, and the +attack speed inner ability line is redundant. IED TARGETS: Lotus through Verus Hilla, 85% minimum and 93% ideal; Black Mage through lower-difficulty Grandis bosses, 95% minimum; hard bosses, 97% or better. WSE POTENTIAL: between 9/0/0 and 7/2/0 attack/boss/IED lines is considered the ideal band, and the doc advises dropping IED lines off WSE later since set effects and other sources cover it. COOLDOWN HAT: the doc calls Buccaneer the worst class in the game for a cooldown hat and says a stat hat wins by a wide margin; the only exception is a -2 CD hat in min-cut scenarios where it buys one extra burst. RINGS: as of the Frieren collaboration patch Continuous and Ring of Restraint can be worn together; Ring of Restraint gets upgrade priority in both cases - to level 5 so it matches the length of the Origin skill, and to level 6 for the large attack-percentage jump between 5 and 6. All of the above is from The Buccaneer Bible (2026-09-10) unless otherwise noted, and is single-source.

commonMistakes.mistake: Activating or double-clicking the Pirate Blessing link skill.
commonMistakes.why: While the buff is active it swaps the STR and DEX values on your gear, which costs a large amount of damage. You can tell it happened by checking the buff bar.
The class doc rates Buccaneer as the worst class for cooldown hats; a stat hat is better by a large margin outside of -2 CD min-cut edge cases.

commonMistakes.mistake: Putting bossing hyper stat points into Critical Rate.
commonMistakes.why: Buccaneer is already over 100% critical rate against bosses without external sources, and high crit hyper stat levels have poor returns.
The green potion is the last step that takes knuckle attack speed from 9 to 10; without it the class is permanently a stage short.

commonMistakes.mistake: Stopping a Sol Janus investment partway between breakpoints.
commonMistakes.why: Real upgrades land at Sol Janus levels 10, 20 and 30; intermediate levels only add damage and EXP, so a half-finished push is wasted resource.

commonMistakes.mistake: Standing still for long stretches while Lord of the Deep is up.
commonMistakes.why: The toggle stops registering hits after roughly 25 seconds without movement.

commonMistakes.mistake: Skipping the Nautilus Strike boost because the skill is not in the rotation.
commonMistakes.why: The boost is taken for the two extra final-attack lines Nautilus Strike grants to Corkscrew Blow, Octopunch, Serpent Vortex, Howling Fist and the opening cast of Unleash Neptunus, not for casting the skill.

commonMistakes.mistake: Relying on Buccaneer's iframes to survive.
commonMistakes.why: The iframes are tied to the burst - one second per Lightning Form activation up to three, plus the tail end of Howling Fist after its mouth closes - and the class doc advises against treating them as a survival tool.

contest.method: An independent agent re-searched every claim in this file without seeing the researcher's reasoning, and was instructed to refute rather than confirm.
defects: FABRICATED SOURCE ATTRIBUTION - vMatrix.priority[Hook Bomber].consensus: 'Grandis separately ranks the Hook Bomber node SECONDARY.' Grandis ranks it PRIMARY. Verbatim from grandislibrary.com/explorers/buccaneer: PRIMARY = Node 1 (Octopunch), Node 4 (Hook Bomber); SECONDARY = Node 2, Node 3, Node 5; OTHER = Node 6. This is wrong twice over: wrong tier, and wrong about what the tier means (see overconfident #1). It also BURIES A REAL, UNRECORDED CONFLICT: the Bible puts Hook Bomber in Lower Priority while Grandis puts its node in the same tier as Octopunch. That belongs in conflicts[], not softened into a parenthetical.

FABRICATED GLOSS - 'the opening cast of Unleash Neptunus.' The authoritative Nautilus Strike text on maplestorywiki reads: '[Final Attack Skill] 100% chance to strike 2 additional times ... when attacking with Somersault Kick, Corkscrew Blow, Octopunch, Serpent Vortex, Howling Fist, or Release Neptunus. Does not trigger with Neptunus Enrage.' No source says 'the opening cast of Unleash Neptunus' - the game names a distinct skill, Release Neptunus. The file also DROPS Somersault Kick from the list and drops the Neptunus Enrage exclusion. This wrong list appears twice (vMatrix.priority[Raging Serpent Assault + Nautilus Strike].why and commonMistakes[6].why), both times sourced only to the Bible even though maplestorywiki carries the authoritative text.

FABRICATED ORDERING - hexa.order step 1's masteries-before-Sol-Janus sequence. No source states it; the file's own conflicts[2] declares that no textual HEXA levelling order was obtainable. Listed here as well as under overconfident because it is precisely the failure mode the file warns about.
